ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the images: the left image shows the exterior of the Abu Simbel Temple, with huge seated stone statues in front of the temple entrance, and the whole seems to have been carved out of the mountain body; the right image shows that the temple interior is relatively dark, and the stone statues in the depths are illuminated by a beam of strong light entering from outside, presenting a specific lighting wonder. Then reason: the question stem explains that this “Sun Festival” wonder is when the glow of the rising sun enters through the temple gate, passes through a temple corridor of about 60 meters, and shines on the stone statues in the depths, and it occurs only on the two days each year that are Ramses II’s birthday and foundation-laying day. Therefore, the most critical thing for appreciating this wonder is not to arrive at any time, but to watch on the correct date and at the correct moment, that is, to grasp the timing for viewing.

raw_record.question_text: What should one pay the most attention to when appreciating the wonder of the “Sun Festival”?
